video_title: Perk says LeBron James and the 76ers can ‘WIN THE CHAMPIONSHIP this season’ 👀 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's health is a major factor for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is a huge swing piece in this one.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: As excited as we are about LeBron James, Joel Embiid is a huge swing piece in this one. What does that look like?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The thing about LeBron James is he can play multiple positions on the floor. If he is in that four position and Joel Embiid is potentially healthy, you have a threat in terms of scoring in the paint, you have an outstanding facilitator, and you have a high basketball IQ guy that will take the shots that are given off of this offense.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe add dangerous speed to Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: The speed of Edgecombe and Maxey already made this Philadelphia 76ers squad more dangerous.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: The speed of VJ Edgecombe and Tyrese Maxey already made this Philadelphia 76ers squad more dangerous than I think people were prepared for this past season. They are only going to take a step forward.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: You look at what Jaylen Brown has done in his previous role with this Celtics team that most people thought did not have the adequate amount of talent to compete in the East and what he was able to do. The elements of this team that make them the most dangerous is that they will be able to both play fast and a powerful style of basketball given how healthy they can be.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James values high-IQ players like Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: High-IQ players are something LeBron has always wanted to play with.
quotes.quote: What Monica said about high-IQ is very important. High-IQ players are something LeBron has always wanted to play with. While Joel Embiid's health has often failed him, no one would ever say he is anything but a high-IQ player. I think they can figure out how to play together.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The connection between LeBron James and Tyrese Maxey is vital
quotes.excerpt: When you are going into a situation where there is not going to be clearly defined roles, the connection with the point guard is vital.
quotes.quote: I cannot overemphasize enough the importance of the connection with Tyrese Maxey. When you are going into a situation where there is not going to be clearly defined roles and you are not going to be sure how it might work with Jaylen Brown and VJ Edgecombe is still finding his way in the league, the connection with the point guard is vital. These are two guys who have spent a lot of time together through Klutch Sports. LeBron was part of the recruitment process of him to Klutch Sports back when he was in high school and in college. All of these things are major factors.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James has a deeper comfort level with Tyrese Maxey than James Harden
quotes.excerpt: The comfort level with Tyrese Maxey is clearly deeper than the comfort level with James Harden.
quotes.quote: When I compare it to the James Harden decision, it is not comparing James Harden and Tyrese Maxey as players, but the comfort level with Tyrese Maxey is clearly deeper than the comfort level with James Harden. And I honestly believe that was part of it. Do I know how this team is going to play today? No. Does Nick Nurse know how this team is going to play today? No. But are you going to bet on the connection between Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James? It is a reasonable thing to bet on.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers with LeBron James are legitimate title contenders
quotes.excerpt: The Philadelphia 76ers with LeBron James can win a championship this year with this roster.
quotes.quote: Let me just keep it real. The Philadelphia 76ers with LeBron James can win a championship this year with this roster. LeBron James loves to play with a bunch of dogs. If you go and you check his history of the teams that he won a championship with, they had dogs. And this is what the Philadelphia 76ers, this is what they have.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' versatility makes him an asset for any team
quotes.excerpt: He has been asked to do a lot of different roles, offensively and defensively.
quotes.quote: Think about this: he has been asked to do a lot of different roles, offensively and defensively. We saw him with the Lakers, he was asked in the playoff series to play the center position. And guess what? He actually did a damn good job doing it. And so when you think about the top dog, the defending champs, the New York Knicks, if they happen to get their match up in the playoff series, LeBron James has no problem with going and calling Anthony Davis. Matter of fact, you could go check the numbers and go look at LeBron James and his match up against Anthony Davis when he had to defend him and he has done an outstanding job.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse knows how to put players in position to succeed
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse knows what it takes to put those guys in position to be successful.
quotes.quote: You are talking about Nick Nurse. Nick Nurse knows what it takes to put those guys in position to be successful. They are legitimate title contenders. Yes, they could win a championship this year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia's fully built roster makes them immediate contenders
quotes.excerpt: The 76ers do not have to hollow anything out. They have got a fully built roster.
quotes.quote: The other times that he changed teams, those teams had to hollow themselves out to open up the cap space to sign him. So this is not comparable. The 76ers do not have to hollow anything out. They have got a fully built roster. So the expectation, like Perk was saying, should be to win immediately.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's fit is the key to Philadelphia's success
quotes.excerpt: One of the key things I am interested now in is the Jaylen Brown fit.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown did not select playing for the 76ers. He has expressed an interest in making this a really successful situation. He did not pick it. So to me, one of the key things I am interested now in is the Jaylen Brown fit. We may all be paying attention to how LeBron fits because he is one of the greatest players of all time, but to me, the work that the 76ers have to do now is with Jaylen Brown and explain to Jaylen Brown what his role is.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown wants to make the Celtics look stupid
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is at a space right now where he wants to make the Celtics look stupid.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is at a space right now where he wants to make the Celtics look stupid. And by doing that is bringing a championship to Philadelphia. And I go back to Jaylen Brown. Yes, we saw him last year. Yes, we saw him showing the world that he actually could be a number one option. But I did go back to his championship years. He shared the floor with Jayson Tatum, Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Kristaps Porzingis, and he found a way and he sacrificed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: It will take time to evaluate the 76ers' championship potential
quotes.excerpt: It is going to be a long time before we figure out whether they truly can win four playoff series.
quotes.quote: There is no way you can evaluate the 76ers team for a long, long time. We can be excited about it, they can play big games, it is going to be a long time before we figure out whether they truly can win four playoff series.
